newsitem.title: USA: Dean Witter CEO received $4.3 mln in '96 - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Dean Witter CEO received $4.3 mln in '96 - WSJ.

text.p: Dean Witter Discover & Co Chairman and Chief Executive Philip Purcell received $4.3 million in cash and stock last year, the Wall Street Journal said in Monday's electronic edition.
He received $1.1 million in salary and other compensation plus a $3.2 million bonus, 20 percent of which was deferred, the newspaper said citing the firm's proxy statement.
The Journal said Purcell's 1996 pay package was smaller than those of all five of merger partner Morgan Stanley's top executives.
